services.desc: Online MMA training should connect striking and grappling instead of teaching them as separate playlists. You may already box, kickbox, wrestle, train Jiu-Jitsu, or spend enough time watching MMA to understand the pieces. The harder problem is learning how those pieces work together and deciding what deserves your training time now. TRITAC builds your starting plan around the skills you already use and the areas that need development. The goal is not to make you collect more techniques.
